summary: OpenAI announced an improved GPT-5.6 Sol model in ChatGPT with better accuracy and consistency, and expanded free-user access to GPT-5.6 Luna including unlimited everyday chats.

mechanisms.reason: Expanding free-tier access and offering unlimited everyday chats increases the volume of chat interactions served.
mechanisms.quote: expanding access to GPT-5.6 Luna for free users. ChatGPT introduces improved GPT-5.6 Sol with better accuracy and consistency, plus expanded access for free users and unlimited everyday chats with GPT-5.6 Luna.

practices.reason: The summary states an incremental accuracy and consistency improvement to an existing chat model, with no benchmark detail to act on.
practices.quote: ChatGPT introduces improved GPT-5.6 Sol with better accuracy and consistency
